one_loop.verdict: Anchored one-loop threshold chain reproduces the manuscript M_I/M_GUT. Continuous one-loop Spin(10) running from the spectator-corrected alpha_GUT does not justify resetting alpha_10(v_Phi)=1/40 (continuous alpha_inv(v_Phi)~15.83). Planck-scale coupling remains model-dependent on the heavy beta. These are one-loop numbers: their two-loop counterparts are UNAVAILABLE (two_loop.unavailable).

content.spectators: none (5 x (16+16bar) at M_s = M_I: see unavailable)

method.beta_functions: Machacek-Vaughn two-loop gauge, exact Fraction b_i, b_ij (coefficients)
method.matching: tree level at M_I and M_GUT
method.integrator: fixed-step RK4 in t = ln mu, h <= 0.02, standard library only
method.root: grid scan of log10 M_I on [8, 14.5] (step 0.25) + bisection, xtol 1e-12
method.sources: M.E. Machacek and M.T. Vaughn, Nucl. Phys. B222 (1983) 83 [two-loop gauge beta, general theory]; D.R.T. Jones, Phys. Rev. D25 (1982) 581; SM check against the literature values b = (41/10, -19/6, -7), b_ij = [[199/50, 27/10, 44/5], [9/10, 35/6, 12], [11/10, 9/2, -26]] (e.g. Luo, Wang, Xiao, Phys. Rev. D67 (2003) 065019); the same Fractions were derived independently in the D-C audit (workstream P: p1_two_loop_anchor.json; workstream U1: betas.json; workstream U2: PyR@TE) and agree exactly.

unavailable.alpha_inv_GUT_after_spectators: UNAVAILABLE: no perturbative two-loop gauge unification exists with the contract spectators 5 x (16 + 16bar) at M_s = M_I (three independent two-loop codes agree; reproduced by build_report()['spectator_two_loop_probe']). The one-loop additive shift -(40/3)/(2 pi) ln(M_GUT/M_s) does not carry over to two loops because the spectators' two-loop b_ij are non-universal.

unavailable.M_s_GeV: UNAVAILABLE: no perturbative two-loop gauge unification exists with the contract spectators 5 x (16 + 16bar) at M_s = M_I (three independent two-loop codes agree; reproduced by build_report()['spectator_two_loop_probe']). unavailable.continuous_spin10: UNAVAILABLE: continuous two-loop Spin(10) running above M_GUT needs the contract's two-loop spectator-corrected alpha_GUT at M_GUT as its initial condition, and none exists (no perturbative two-loop gauge unification with 5 x (16 + 16bar) at M_s = M_I; see alpha_inv_GUT_after_spectators). Neither the one-loop 16.81 nor the no-spectator two-loop anchor 33.47 is that matching condition. The former x1.1 heavy-beta factor was not two-loop running and has been removed.

coefficients.convention: t = ln(mu/GeV); d alpha_i^-1/dt = -b_i/(2 pi) - sum_j b_ij alpha_j/(8 pi^2); Machacek-Vaughn with Weyl fermions and complex scalars, S_i(R) = T_i(R) prod_{k!=i} dim_k(R), U(1)_Y GUT-normalised (T = C2 = 3/5 Y^2); row i = running coupling; SM order (U(1)_Y, SU(2)_L, SU(3)_C), PS order (SU(4)_C, SU(2)_L, SU(2)_R); gauge-only (Yukawa terms in the gauge betas omitted)

two_loop.verdict: Genuine two-loop Machacek-Vaughn gauge running of the anchor content without spectators (2HDM below M_I, Pati-Salam (1,2,2)+(10bar,1,3)+(15,2,2) above) gives M_I = 6.561e+10 GeV, M_GUT = 1.252e+16 GeV, alpha_U^-1 = 33.469; it does not reproduce the manuscript's one-loop M_I/M_GUT and it is not the declared benchmark. The two-loop coupling after the 5 x (16+16bar) spectators at M_s = M_I and the two-loop Spin(10) running are UNAVAILABLE (see unavailable).

honest_limitation: The two-loop entry is genuine Machacek-Vaughn two-loop gauge running of the anchor content without spectators (gauge-only; Yukawa terms in the gauge betas and one-loop threshold matching are omitted; the independent codes' variants move M_I to 6.6-7.1e10 GeV). The two-loop spectator-corrected coupling and the two-loop Spin(10) running are UNAVAILABLE. The former constant-shift two-loop proxy was not two-loop running and has been removed.
